description: This file defines a PHPUnit test class 'CopyActivityAPITest' for testing the CopyProjectActivityAPI related to copying activities in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It contains methods for testing 'getAll', 'create', and unimplemented 'delete' functionalities, including data providers for parameterized tests.

classes.name: CopyActivityAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the CopyProjectActivityAPI's functionality in the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of CopyProjectActivityAPI using data provider.

methods.description: Tests the 'create' method of CopyProjectActivityAPI using data provider.
